ns2:course.label: Strategies of Architectural Design
ns2:course.description: Strategies of Architectural Design focuses on understanding the importance of site in relationship to human scale and the built environment through precedent analysis of typology, street, block and neighborhood. In addition, students will be introduced to basic strategies of architectural design and how these strategies are implemented through tectonics and materiality. No undergraduate credit. 1 to 3 graduate hours.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: No undergraduate credit. 1 to 3 graduate hours.
